item.title: Parliament Asks Kenyans for Comment on Budget That Doubles State House Spending
item.description: The State House budget will rise to Ksh17 billion if MPs approve the supplementary budget ahead of the creation of the 2026/2027 budget set to be announced in June.

item.title: Ndindi Nyoro Speaks Amid Reports of Arrest
item.description: Tension in Kiharu after administrators skipped Ndindi Nyoro’s Kahuro ACC offices event, prompting him to publicly challenge their decision.

item.title: WRC Safari Rally Stage 3 Cancelled Due to Poor Road Conditions
item.description: The Met has warned of further rains over the weekend, making the rally championship even more gripping for fans and challenging for drivers.

item.title: KeNHA Gives Ultimatum to Illegal Occupants Along Section of Mombasa Road
item.description: KeNHA has in recent years stepped up efforts to reclaim road reserves across major highways as part of broader initiatives to enhance road safety and reduce accidents

item.title: KeNHA Reopens Mai Mahiu–Suswa–Narok Road Ahead of Weekend Rush
item.description: The road offers alternatives for people running away from the Nairobi-Nakuru Highway, which is often unpredictable, causing gridlock for hours.

item.title: CS Kabogo Reveals 4 Upcoming Changes to TikTok
item.description: Kabogo stressed that while innovation must continue to thrive, it must be balanced with transparency and responsible governance to ensure that the digital space remains safe.

item.title: Wajir Stadium to Be Completed in May Ahead of Madaraka Day, PS Announces
item.description: For the first time, the Madaraka Day celebrations will be held in Northern Kenya after President Ruto's orders to decentralise the national event.

item.title: KRA Explains AI System to Catch Tax Cheats Amid Uproar
item.description: KRA seeks to seal all tax leaks, with advanced tech in mind, and the question of whether the authority will incorporate AI into its systems is up for debate.

item.title: Kenya Met Warns of Heavy Rains in 5 Regions This Weekend
item.description: The meteorological department called on residents living in the mentioned regions to be on the lookout for potential flooding, with the rains set to last for five days.

item.title: Ruto Approves Creation of New Fund
item.description: Ruto expects to borrow Ksh125 billion through the new fund this year, and up to Ksh390 billion to fund the expansion of the SGR to Malaba.
